index.html.title: Christina Nortman, CPA | Business Tax Planning | AE Tax
index.html.description: Meet Christina Nortman, CPA, through AE Tax Advisors. Review business-owner advisory scope, engagement fees and records to prepare for a planning discussion.
index.html.heading: Start with the decision your business needs to make
index.html.body:
Review AE’s business-owner tax planning services and published fees and engagement scope. Identify whether you need ongoing planning, transaction-specific support or return coordination.

Bring current financials, ownership and entity details, existing adviser responsibilities and the decision deadline. Book a discovery conversation to confirm fit, deliverables and the team assigned to your work.
